scenario_name: Customer asks for the shipping address the agent already shared moments ago
judge_summary: The assistant successfully fulfilled both of the user’s concrete needs: checking the Galaxy Watch order status and confirming the shipping address. Responses were accurate, concise, and context-aware. The main area for improvement is making the conversational tone at the end of the interaction feel a bit less abrupt and more naturally closing the exchange.

criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user asks, “can you remind me what shipping address you have on that order again?”, the bot later responds with “The shipping address on that Galaxy Watch order is: Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich,” thus providing the shipping address again.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the conversation does the bot state or imply that it has lost access to prior data or tools it had just used; it simply retrieves and reports the address again.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: In response to the follow-up about the shipping address, the bot directly provides the address for the Galaxy Watch order without listing any other orders or going through a full re-listing process.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: After the initial discussion of the Galaxy Watch order, the bot does not ask again which order the user means; it directly references “that Galaxy Watch order” and provides the address.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: Each user request (order status and delivery address) was answered clearly, specifically, and correctly without missing details.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: The user never indicated misunderstanding or correction needs, so there were no repair opportunities mishandled.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referenced the same order and address across turns and correctly retrieved the requested details without contradictions.
